name: fitclub
description: FITCLUB — fitness club platform: public website, member portal and administration in one monorepo.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @fitclub/shared" "npm run dev -w @fitclub/api" "npm run dev -w @fitclub/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fitclub/shared && npm run build -w @fitclub/api && npm run build -w @fitclub/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @fitclub/api" "npm run start -w @fitclub/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @fitclub/shared && npm run test -w @fitclub/api
